LESSON: FAMILY NEEDS AND WANTS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social Environment
Topic 1.2: Family needs and wants
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Family needs and wants, part of Social Environment in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we meet our family needs?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Family needs and wants together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Love: learner portrays a caring attitude towards peers when playing games of picking out flash cards/paper cuttings/pictures that show family

needs.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills: Learner enhances family life skills when sorting and grouping pictures of goods and services into family needs and wants.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Family needs and wants can be used to learn the skill of counting, sorting and grouping in Mathematics Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

Approved support learning materials, flash cards, braille cards, pictures, digital devices with assistive technology, pictures of different foods,

house and clothes, foods such as flour, vegetables, clothes
